# harborpilot_event_catalog (Data Source)

Lists the domain event kinds the server emits, for building event filters on destinations and notification rules.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "harborpilot_event_catalog" "all" {}

output "critical_events" {
  value = [for e in data.harborpilot_event_catalog.all.events : e.name if e.severity == "critical"]
}
```
